plugins.name: Local redaction
plugins.description: Replaces names, organizations, places, contact details, ID numbers, credentials and dates in a message and its attachments with placeholders before it is sent; Word documents and PDFs with a text layer go as redacted text. Runs on your own computer; you review the change before it goes. Needs Python 3.10+ and about 2 GB for its model.
plugins.author: LibraOS
